article.title: 生效提醒：ChatGPT Ads創意優化預設啟用，品牌應重查設定
article.title_en: Effective-date reminder: review ChatGPT Ads’ default creative enhancements

article.detail:
OpenAI現行說明列明，10月30日起新舊廣告活動預設啟用創意優化。系統可按現有廣告與落地頁內容調整文案、圖片尺寸、目的網址及語言。

增強版本可毋須逐個預覽或批准便投放；現有帳戶與活動層級退出設定會保留。

活動設定優先於帳戶預設；廣告主仍可隨時在Ads Manager調整。原始電郵報道日期為10月20日。

當投放版本可自動改字及換落地頁，品牌審核應延伸至來源頁內容與活動設定，尤其涉及優惠及產品限制。

逐個帳戶確認是否保留自動優化，核對活動覆蓋設定，並更新過期價格、優惠及存貨資訊。

此文為已公告安排的生效提醒，並非生效日首次公布；現行官方頁與原電郵的生效日一致，舊報道曾記錄日期差異。未登入驗證個別帳戶是否已切換，亦不把整體CTR變動視為功能因果效果。
article.detail_en:
OpenAI’s current guidance lists October 30 as the start of default creative enhancements for new and existing campaigns, adapting copy, image sizes, destination URLs and language from existing ads and landing pages.

Enhanced versions can run without approval of every variation; existing account and campaign opt-outs are retained.

Campaign settings override account defaults and remain editable in Ads Manager. The original email report was published October 20.

When delivery can change copy and landing pages, brand review should cover source-page accuracy and campaign settings, especially promotions and product restrictions.

Confirm the enhancement choice for each account, inspect campaign overrides and update outdated prices, offers and availability.

This is an effective-date reminder, not a new October 30 announcement. Current official guidance says October 30; older reporting recorded conflicting dates. Individual account activation and causal performance effects were not tested.
